description: This file contains code for a voice-driven drive-thru ordering bot for a donut shop called 'Dr. Donut'. It defines functions for handling secret menu retrieval, bot operation with a specified transport, and the main entry point. The code configures an AI language model with prompts and integrations with various pipelines, tools, and transports, to process user voice input and respond accordingly.

classes.name: FunctionSchema
classes.description: Schema for defining a function interface available for language model invocation.

classes.name: ToolsSchema
classes.description: Schema for grouping multiple tools that can be used by the language model.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents a sequence of processing steps for handling user input and producing responses.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages execution and lifecycle of a processing pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Parameters configuring pipeline behaviors such as metrics and timeouts.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline and its associated parameters for execution.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Context object for managing interactions with the language model.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pair of aggregators for managing LLM contexts.

classes.name: UltravoxRealtimeLLMService
classes.description: A service wrapper for the UltraVox real-time LLM API.

classes.name: BaseTransport
classes.description: Base class for transport mechanisms (e.g., WebSocket, HTTP).

methods.name: get_secret_menu(params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Fetches secret menu items based on category argument and returns them in a callback.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Configures and runs the voice interaction pipeline with a specified transport and runner arguments.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main entry point that initializes transport and starts the bot operation.
